questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure Functions?

options.text: Technology for running cloud capabilities closer to devices and where data is generated

questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure functions
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Serverless compute: a model in which developers focus on code while the platform manages the underlying servers and scaling.
Azure Functions: running resources only as needed and charging primarily for the execution resources consumed.
Event trigger: a template that can include an operating system and preinstalled components for rapid VM deployment.
Serverless compute: a stateful extension in which the runtime coordinates and tracks state across function activity.
Azure Functions: an event-driven serverless compute service that runs code in response to triggers.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Azure Functions — an event-driven serverless compute service that runs code in response to triggers; and Serverless compute — a model in which developers focus on code while the platform manages the underlying servers and scaling.
